review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped the sheaf-cohomology library for repeated lemma uses (coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom, homologyMap_mapNatTrans). The naturality lemmas on acyclic resolutions, the filtered-resolution lemmas and the final colimit comparison proof each use different arguments, so I did not report them. The one real repetition is the degreewise ι-compatibility of the comparison iso, which is proved three times. It is a small amount of reasoning, so the finding is modest. I did not compile any proposed rewrite.

findings.problem: The same ι-compatibility fact for the degreewise comparison iso is proved three times. `hn` (n = n) and `hm` (n = m) inside `ofFunctorColimIso` each restate it with the long `coconePointUniqueUpToIso` expression and discharge it with the same `IsColimit.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom` call. `ofFunctorColimitι_comp_ofFunctorColimIso_hom` (lines 192–194) then proves it again with the same call. The statement is written out in full twice, and the `isColimitOfPreserves ...` arguments are retyped three times.
findings.proposed_change: Before `ofFunctorColimIso`, add a private helper stating the fact once for an arbitrary index k. First set `def ofFunctorColimIsoComponent (D) (k : κ) := (colimit.isColimit (D ⋙ eval A shape k)).coconePointUniqueUpToIso (isColimitOfPreserves (eval A shape k) (colimit.isColimit D))`. Then add `lemma ι_ofFunctorColimIsoComponent_hom (D) (k : κ) (t : T) : colimit.ι (D ⋙ eval A shape k) t ≫ (ofFunctorColimIsoComponent D k).hom = (colimit.ι D t).f k`, proved by `IsColimit.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom _ _ t`. Rewrite the `isoOfComponents` data as `ofFunctorColimIsoComponent D`. The commutation proof then becomes `rw [ι_ofFunctorColimIsoComponent_hom D n t, ι_colimMap, Category.assoc, ι_ofFunctorColimIsoComponent_hom D m t]` followed by `exact (colimit.ι D t).comm n m`. The two `have` blocks disappear. `ofFunctorColimitι_comp_ofFunctorColimIso_hom` becomes `ext n; exact ι_ofFunctorColimIsoComponent_hom D n t`.
findings.benefit: The identification of the colimit-of-components with the colimit's components is proved once and named, so readers can see it is the only input to the d-compatibility and to the ι-factorisation. The three long copies shrink to one. A change to how the componentwise iso is built would then be made in one place.
